parsed.notes: Reviewed under Lens B only. No web or non-disclosed authority was used.

defect.problem: The authority exists as a Sixth Circuit slip-only/publication record, but the assertion payload overstates the citation metadata by flagging an official citation as present. The lake record has no official citation and marks the case slip-only.
defect.proposed_fix: Keep the slip-style citation, but set official_citation_present to false or rename that metadata field to citation_present.

reasons: Lake identity verifies United States v. Edward Leonidas Lewis, 6th Cir., docket 22-5593, decided 2023-09-01.
Lake citations show official citation is null and slip_only is true; no disclosed record supplies a Federal Reporter citation.
residual_risks: Live-law status is not independently verified because treatment/progeny are frontier-stub unverified.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: State explicitly that the citation is slip-only/no official reporter citation confirmed.

reasons: Lens B does not test holding support or quote fidelity.
No disclosed treatment edge supersedes, overrules, abrogates, or limits the holding; the lake treatment record is unverified with empty edges.
residual_risks: Current good-law status is not affirmatively verified because the treatment/progeny fields are explicitly unverified.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Keep the unverified-treatment caveat attached to this holding.

reasons: Lens B does not evaluate topical home-role support.
No disclosed treatment record contradicts use on Consent Searches; content_page.md itself lists Consent Searches with role Key.
residual_risks: The Key role may warrant later reassessment after treatment/progeny verification completes.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: If corpus policy requires verified treatment for Key cases, defer Key status until S6/S9 promotion.

reasons: The lake identity places the case in the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit, circuit ca6.
The disclosed provenance describes it as RECOMMENDED FOR PUBLICATION / Published; nothing in the disclosed treatment fields limits or negates precedential weight.
residual_risks: Later negative treatment is not ruled out because treatment/progeny are unverified.

reasons: The content treatment fields match the lake treatment fields: field_i_validity unverified, as_of_content null, as_of_treatment null, composite_basis unverified, and varies_by_point false.
The lake record expressly says treatment/progeny were not derived and contains no progeny or treatment edges.
residual_risks: This is not a good-law verification; it is only an accurate unverified-treatment status.
